choices.content: The two plans cost the same

question.prompt: Plan A has a monthly fee of 30 yuan plus 0.1 yuan/minute; Plan B has no monthly fee and charges 0.15 yuan/minute. If someone makes 500 minutes of calls per month, which plan saves more money?

solutions.explanation: Plan A: \(30+0.1\times500=80\) yuan; Plan B: \(0.15\times500=75\) yuan. Plan B costs less. (The two plans cost the same when \(30+0.1t=0.15t\), giving \(t=600\). Plan B costs less for fewer than 600 minutes of calls.)
solutions.title: Compare total charges

solutions.explanation: Plan A saves \(0.15-0.10=0.05\) yuan per minute in call charges. Over \(500\) minutes, this saves \(0.05\times500=25\) yuan. Its monthly fee is \(30\) yuan, which exceeds these savings by \(30-25=5\) yuan. Therefore, Plan B costs \(5\) yuan less. Choose B.
